posts.body:
Engine:
Rpg Maker Mv
Intro:
The game opens with the player, Ein Conner, sitting in principal's Hatly office. Hatly is discussing with him about the summer school program because of his current grade levels. Ein's parents died earlier in the school year and since Ein transferred schools to live with his grandfather, his grades have dropped considerably. Principal Hatly says that he understands his circumstances, but he needs to find his summer spirit and get out of the slump he's in or he will be forced to repeat the grade.  That evening, as it rains, Ein's walks to the local arcade. Along the way, he passes a girl sitting on the sidewalk crying with her head in her lap. Thinking twice about it, Ein turns around to see if there's anything he can do to help but when he does, she is gone. Afterwards, at the arcade, Ein sees a group of fellow classmates, one of which, is a girl named Trinny that Ein has a crush on, as he tries to get up the nerve to talk to her, Trinny and her group leave the arcade. Sulking, he returns to the game he was playing. after a few minutes of getting frustrated at the game, or himself, Ein is about to hit the machine when head pops out of it. It's the girl he saw on the street. Stunned Ein falls backwards and hits his head on the ground. When he recovers, all that is present is him and the machine he was playing on. He calls it a night and heads home. The next morning as He opens his eyes, Ein is greeted by a set of curious eyes staring back at him. After a moment, He realizes they belong to the girl from the previous day. He also realizes that this girl is floating above him....   It's going to be an interesting summer...
Synopsis:
My Summer Spirit is a slice of life, anime styled game, that revolves around Ein, the main protagonist, and Sam, a spirit that only Sam can see. The two make a pack to help each other out, Sam will help Ein to date his high school crush, Trinny, And Ein will help Sam to crossover. The game itself takes place over the course of summer vacation.

Game will mostly be non commercial but may change depending on how everyone feels closer to completion
Positions/Roles Needed:
Coder/scripters
Writers
Music Technician
Possibly someone who can do still images for certain scenes.
Really just looking for anyone one who would like to contribute.
My Role(s)/Position(s):
I will be doing a majority of the work. Ranging from graphics, writing, screen writing, basically filling in where needed.
Skill Trade:
I'm not sure how much extra time I will have but depending on what you are contributing/ role your helping with, I may be able to do some smaller sprite work for your game.
I will be adding more to this page but I'm out of time for today.
I have a decent overall Idea for the bigger storyline. I will be adding more later but this is strictly a side hobby game. If this seem like something you would be interested in joining, feel free to shoot me a message.
Thank you for your time,
KillerPixeel
